# Montage Event Management

> Montage Event Management is an event services company based in Selangor serving all of Malaysia. It provides portable bar and bartending, live BBQ and shisha catering, 360° photobooth rental, sound and lighting, inflatables and entertainers for weddings, corporate events and private parties across Malaysia.

Official website: https://montageevents.my

## Key pages
- [Home — services and packages](https://montageevents.my/): overview of all services
- [Book online](https://montageevents.my/bookings): choose a package, pick a date and pay the RM500 deposit to secure it
- [360° Photobooth](https://montageevents.my/photobooth): photobooth rental
- [Wedding Bar Service in Malaysia](https://montageevents.my/wedding-bar-malaysia/): Portable wedding bar with custom signature cocktails and mocktails for weddings across Malaysia. Book online with a RM500 deposit.
- [Event Management Company in Malaysia](https://montageevents.my/event-management-malaysia/): Event management company serving all of Malaysia: bar service, live BBQ, shisha, 360° photobooth, sound & lighting, inflatables and entertainers for weddings, corporate and private events.
- [Live BBQ & Shisha Catering in Malaysia](https://montageevents.my/bbq-catering-malaysia/): Live BBQ stations and shisha lounges for weddings, corporate and private events across Malaysia. Book online with a RM500 deposit.
- [360° Photobooth Rental in Malaysia](https://montageevents.my/photobooth-rental-malaysia/): 360° spin photobooth rental with slow-motion videos and instant share links for weddings, corporate and private events across Malaysia.
- [Terms](https://montageevents.my/terms), [Refund policy](https://montageevents.my/refund-policy), [Privacy policy](https://montageevents.my/privacy-policy)
